name: KromiumErrorCode
summary: Standardized error codes for programmatic recovery and telemetry.

enumConstants.name: UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM
enumConstants.description: The current OS/architecture is not supported.

enumConstants.name: INSTALLATION_FAILED
enumConstants.description: Failed to unpack or install the engine binaries.

enumConstants.name: DOWNLOAD_DISABLED
enumConstants.description: Engine download is disabled but binaries were not found.

enumConstants.name: NO_BUNDLE_AVAILABLE
enumConstants.description: No binary bundle available for this platform.

enumConstants.name: CHECKSUM_MISMATCH
enumConstants.description: Downloaded bundle checksum does not match expected hash.

enumConstants.name: MALICIOUS_ARCHIVE
enumConstants.description: Zip Slip or path traversal detected in archive.

enumConstants.name: BOOTSTRAP_FAILED
enumConstants.description: Bootstrap sequence failed to locate or initialize engine.

enumConstants.name: INSTALLATION_CORRUPTED
enumConstants.description: Existing installation files are corrupt or incomplete.

enumConstants.name: INVALID_CONFIG
enumConstants.description: Provided configuration is invalid or missing required fields.

enumConstants.name: FRAMEWORK_REQUIRED
enumConstants.description: UI framework must be explicitly specified.

enumConstants.name: CANVAS_NOT_AVAILABLE
enumConstants.description: Rendering surface canvas is not yet ready or visible.
